A separated C1 conformal IFS yields shift conjugacy and the dimension squeeze between perturbed pressure roots. Expanding the root of h^-s(1+2^(1-s))=1 gives coefficient (ln2)^2 ln3(4+ln3)/9 in 1/(ln h)^3; the dimension squeeze error is O(1/[h(ln h)^2]). Exact symbolic factorization and Taylor coefficients independently checked against the frozen proof, with no extrapolation from finite h.
